t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are gnomes with earthy (green/yellow) and not so earthy (pink, orange) colours. A group will generally give more than the other, but which group that is changes over time. It is recommended to test for changes on a x1 round to maximise your earnings in a x5.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of gnomes, the more yellow based colours (yellow, orange, brown) and the more blue/green based colours (blue, green, pink). Every screen will have one from either category. At different points in the game, one category will have a higher yield than the other. The changes in yield will be gradual, so stick with a category until the yield gets low. Use the x1 rounds to experiment if you think the yield is too low from the current category, and judge based on that whether or not to switch.
